name: OpenShell
description: Installs the NVIDIA OpenShell CLI and gateway and starts the gateway with the Docker compute driver at container start (no systemd). Telemetry is disabled by default.

version.description: OpenShell release to install ('0.1.7', 'latest' or another version; a leading 'v' is optional). 'none' installs only the start scripts.

installGateway.description: Install openshell-gateway and start it at container start. Needs a Docker daemon (docker-in-docker).

telemetry.description: Allow OpenShell gateway telemetry. When false, the gateway is started with OPENSHELL_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false.
